name: NexusFolio
tagline: An AI advisor that knows your actual holdings and gives portfolio-specific investment advice.
problem: Financial advice is either expensive or generic and blind to what you own.
solution: Tracks the user's real portfolio and uses retrieval over market information to give contextual recommendations, behind authentication.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask whether to rebalance and get advice about your own stocks.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Smart Economies Hack” and “[MLH] Best Use of Auth0” among 124 submissions.
Advice grounded in the user's portfolio.

lessons: Personal context turns a generic chatbot into a product.
